reviews.disposition: B2 F1–F5 source tables are bounded October 14 observations, not current whole-tree absence claims. Preserve separate four-field bio serialization versus added-body record, identity/address versus anatomy, disabled additive race/height data versus replaced owned buckets, actual native combat/pursuit/craft versus similarly named helper hosts, parked versus controlled body and codec versus real-loader proof. B8’s later parent-chain correction routes Body & recovery to Notebook → Practice, superseding B2’s old Local actions instruction. No currently missing pronoun/body/stealth subsystem is concluded from old term searches alone.

reviews.classification: fully reviewed source-local body/projection/modification proposal with unrun delivery gates
reviews.disposition: G24-B2.1–.6 propose an optional native body record, neutral unsupported-world translation, independent identity/address, mechanism-specific quirks and observer claims. Keep own source/faculty activation and native body identity; a card/ref or reserved empty genetics field grants neither power nor diagnosis. Pinned profile factors and eight examples are local dials, not universal race/species policy. Idempotent bucket replacement, shared preview/execution chance, once-per-instance application, actual light/body context and no identity-triggered healing are meaningful consumer boundaries. Multi-hour sleep needs actual interval settlement. The “latest observation per field” suggestion must retain independently sourced contradictions/history when a selected diagnostic consumer needs them, consistent with B15; it is not permission to overwrite all earlier claims. Suppression, discovery, read-only projection and acquisition are different operations. Full spec/schema/wireframe review does not implement any of them. G24-B2.M1–M5 already qualify legacy migration as optional. If selected, retain pure normalization/idempotence, absent versus corrupt presence, exact old address/age spellings, unspecified anatomy/pronouns, original native aliases and no grants/creation on load. A neutral record must not erase unknown active definitions or parked-body identity. Explicit serializer/load/probe integration and failed-write preservation remain distinct from JSON shape. No global schema bump is a proposed policy, not guaranteed downgrade or reader compatibility; actual enclosing validators/pack identities govern. Fresh enabled creation requires its own authorized route, not a loaded flag trick. Quota measures include the real envelope/backups/UTF-8/UTF-16; sample targets are not valid-life truncation limits. Native tick ordinary save cadence is not per-tick atomic storage.
